description: This file defines the Address4 class, representing an IPv4 address with methods for validation, parsing, conversion, subnet calculations, and other network-related utilities.

classes.name: Address4
classes.description: A class encapsulating an IPv4 address, providing functionalities for validation, conversion, subnet calculations, and formatting.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes an Address4 instance with an IPv4 address string, parsing subnet if present.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Static method to validate whether a given IPv4 address string is valid.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses and validates the IPv4 address string, splitting into groups.

methods.name: correctForm
methods.description: Returns the IPv4 address in the correct standard form.

methods.name: fromHex
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into an Address4 instance.

methods.name: fromInteger
methods.description: Converts an integer into an Address4 instance.

methods.name: fromArpa
methods.description: Creates an Address4 instance from an in-addr.arpa reverse DNS form.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts the address to its hexadecimal representation.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the address as an array of its numeric octets.

methods.name: toGroup6
methods.description: Converts the IPv4 address to a format suitable for IPv6 grouping.

methods.name: bigInt
methods.description: Returns the address as a BigInt value.

methods.name: _startAddress
methods.description: Calculates the numeric value of the network address based on the subnet.

methods.name: startAddress
methods.description: Returns the first address in the subnet range.

methods.name: startAddressExclusive
methods.description: Returns the first host address in the subnet, excluding the network address.

methods.name: _endAddress
methods.description: Calculates the numeric value of the broadcast address based on the subnet.

methods.name: endAddress
methods.description: Returns the last address in the subnet range.

methods.name: endAddressExclusive
methods.description: Returns the last host address in the subnet, excluding the broadcast address.

methods.name: fromBigInt
methods.description: Creates an Address4 instance from a BigInt.

methods.name: fromByteArray
methods.description: Creates an Address4 from an array of 4 bytes, validating input.

methods.name: fromUnsignedByteArray
methods.description: Creates an Address4 from an array of four unsigned bytes.

methods.name: mask
methods.description: Returns the address bits up to the specified mask length or default subnet mask.

methods.name: getBitsBase2
methods.description: Returns the bits of the address within a specified range as a binary string.

methods.name: reverseForm
methods.description: Returns the reverse DNS form of the address, optionally omitting the suffix.

methods.name: isInSubnet
methods.description: Checks if a given address is within the subnet of the current address.

methods.name: isMulticast
methods.description: Checks if the address is a multicast address.

methods.name: binaryZeroPad
methods.description: Returns a zero-padded binary representation of the address.

methods.name: groupForV6
methods.description: Formats the address for inclusion in an IPv6 address as grouped segments.
